questions.passage: Choose the most appropriate type of Clause/Speech from the alternatives given

questions.q: "I can finish this work by evening," he said.

options.a: He said that he could finish that work by evening.
options.b: He said that he can finish this work by evening.
options.c: He said that he could finish that work by that evening.
options.d: He said that he could finish this work by that evening.

questions.passage: Choose the most appropriate type of Clause/Speech from the alternatives given

dispute.why: Reporting in the past requires all three shifts: 'can' to 'could', the demonstrative 'this' to 'that', and 'evening' to 'that evening'. Only option (c) makes all three. The marked option (d) shifts the tense and the time expression but leaves 'this work' unchanged, and 'this' cannot survive into indirect speech when the reporting verb is past — so the marked answer is wrong here and (c) is correct. Option (a) backshifts 'this' but not the time reference, and (b) backshifts nothing.
